verdict.rationale: The only first-party hint of official SDKs is Stripe's llms.txt, which refers to installing Stripe packages from the npm registry. Identity's own docs show only raw curl calls against the REST API. The MCP server and CLI are separate capabilities and earn no credit toward an SDK story. missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDK libraries and supported languages for Identity, SDK code samples for verification sessions, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: When installing Stripe packages, always check the npm registry for the latest version
